This site collects mathematical definitions, examples, exercises, and proofs in a searchable, cross-referenced form.

## Foundations

- @def-relation defines a relation as a set of ordered pairs.
- @exm-basic-relations records the discrete, empty, and diagonal relations.
- @exr-equal-canonical-relations compares those three basic relations.
- @exr-product-relation-subset describes the product of two relations.

## Analysis

- @exr-de-morgan-union proves De Morgan's law for a countable union, adapted from @Abbott2015.

## Linear Algebra

- @exr-double-negation proves that the additive inverse operation is an involution, adapted from @Axler2024.

## Convex Optimization

The convex-set exercises are adapted from @cvxbook.

- @exr-finite-convex-combinations extends the definition of convexity to arbitrary finite convex combinations.
- @exr-parallel-hyperplanes-distance computes the distance between parallel hyperplanes.
- @exr-voronoi-halfspace derives the halfspace of points closer to one site than another.
